O cartão Automação mostra quanto o agent: The Automation card shows how much the AI agent answered on its own. "Replies written by the agent" is the share of customer replies written by the agent; automated messages are excluded from this count. On the cost side, "Handovers to a person" counts the times the agent handed a customer conversation to a person when that customer has a deal in the sales pipeline. "Human replies outside the system" shows the percentage of team replies sent from a phone, outside Deskcomm. "Customers who repeated themselves after handover" shows how many conversations handed to a person required the customer to repeat what they had already said. "Questions the person had to repeat" also shows, as a percentage, how often the customer sent almost the same sentence again after receiving a reply.
Logo depois da troca, pode aparecer no a: Right after the change, a notice may appear at the top: "The mode change has not reached the server yet." The system already follows the new rule, but the service that stores passwords and creates accounts still uses the old rule. This screen only warns you; it does not fix it automatically. In a standard installation, with everything on one server, the notice shows a command to run on the server, and the change reaches it with the next update. When the database runs on a separate service, as in this photo, no update will fix it: you must change the option manually in the Supabase dashboard, and the notice tells you where. Technical terms in the box, such as "GoTrue" and "DISABLE_SIGNUP", are for whoever manages the server.
A coluna \"Status\" diz em que pé o pedi: The "Status" column tells you where the request stands. For a copy request, "Received" means it is waiting for your approval. For a deletion request, the system starts automatically: if it remains "Received", automatic processing did not run and you can approve it manually. Next comes "Processing", then "Completed" when it finishes. "Review pending" means the system could not finish on its own: the copy is ready but was not emailed (you download and deliver it), or the customer in the deletion request was not found in the CRM. "Failed" means an error occurred three times in a row. To open a request, click "View" at the end of the row.
Feche a prévia e clique em \"Aprovar exp: Close the preview and click "Approve export". The window shows the customer's name and the email address the copy will go to: check that it is the right person, because sending cannot be undone. In "Reason", enter the reason for approval (at least 10 characters) and click "Confirm approval". The request changes to "Processing", and the system creates a PDF with the data and emails it. If the system's email delivery is not configured, or the customer has no email address, the request stays at "Review pending" and a "Download PDF" button appears so you can deliver the file. The button's link is valid for 72 hours.
Em \"Leads recentes\" (lead é o negócio: "Recent leads" (a lead is the deal opened with this customer) shows the deal name, with its sales pipeline and current stage just below. "Pipeline stage" changes the stage without leaving the conversation, and "Open in pipeline" opens the pipeline board with this deal's details already on screen. "Move to another pipeline" changes the deal's pipeline, not just its stage. "This pipeline has no extra fields." simply tells you that this pipeline does not ask for any additional information. "Tasks for this request" and "Contact memory", further up, are other parts of the profile. To continue, click "Collapse" at the top of the profile.
A aba \"Provedor parceiro\" liga um núme: The "Partner provider" tab connects an official WhatsApp Business number through a partner company whose name appears in the card title. You need an account with that company. Paste the "Account" (the number's identifier in the partner's dashboard) and "API key", then click "Connect". The key is tested with the partner before being saved, and the "Not connected" badge changes when it succeeds. Immediately afterward, the screen shows two values to paste into the partner's dashboard. Copy them right away: the secret appears only once, and without this step, customer replies will not arrive.
Check "Use service schedule". Under "How to book", choose "Group with capacity" and enter how many people fit in the class in "Default capacity": here, 6. "Individual by professional" is for serving one person at a time; in that case, also choose the professionals under "Additional options". "Group without automatic limit" does not count available spots. "Enable bookings for this service" is checked by default; unchecked, the service stays in draft and accepts no bookings. To save with bookings enabled, you need at least one time slot, which is the next step.
Abre um formulário curto. \"Nome\" é o q: A short form opens. "Name" is what the customer and team will read. "Category" groups the type (consultation, follow-up, procedure…). "Duration (minutes)" says how much time the appointment takes in the calendar. "Where it takes place" can be in person, by phone, WhatsApp, video link, or Google Meet; Google Meet only generates a link when Google Calendar is connected. "Create as a draft service" is for setting up a custom schedule before opening bookings: the type starts disabled with no assigned provider, and you adjust it later using the "Configure" button in its row.
Com a Stripe escolhida de novo em 'Prove: With Stripe selected again under 'Provider', paste the key you copied from its dashboard (Developers › API keys) and click 'Test and connect'. The system checks the key with the provider before saving anything. If accepted, it registers payment notifications and stores the key securely. Start with the test key. Switching to the production key is what makes charges real: if any company subscribed in test mode, the system asks for confirmation with 'Publish anyway', because that company returns to the free trial.
\"Atendentes podem mexer na agenda dos c: "Staff can manage colleagues' calendars" is on by default: any staff member can view, cancel, and reschedule any colleague's appointments and manage team tasks. When off, each person manages only their own; managers and administrators can still manage everything. This rule takes effect as soon as you click. Just below, "Meeting Meet links start with open access" lets anyone with the link join without requesting permission. It requires Google Calendar to be connected, and anyone already connected must reconnect their calendar for the option to take effect.
No Admin, o item \"E-mail\" do menu abre: In Admin, the "Email" menu item opens this installation's email server settings. Team invitations, delivery of data requested under the LGPD, and deadline notices are sent through here. What you configure on this screen applies to every company on the server, not just your clinic. Until your own email server is saved, a yellow "No SMTP configured" banner may appear at the top of every Admin screen (SMTP is the technical name for an email server). Its "Configure at /admin/email" shortcut brings you here.
Para quem é atendente, boa parte dos núm: For staff members, many figures count only what that person can see: deals and conversations assigned to them and, with the installation's default settings, those still unassigned. That is why the Conversion card shows won deals Ana can see, rather than the whole clinic's, and conversations that went silent are counted only among those she can see. Request counts (the base at the top of Friction, "Closed requests", and "Open requests without a next step") still cover the entire clinic.
Não há botão de salvar: a escolha vale a: There is no save button: the choice takes effect as soon as you click the switch, and another click reverses it. Each change is recorded under "Audit" in the menu, with the date, time, and partially hidden email address of whoever changed it. The Audit screen is technical and in English: the change appears as "platform.signup_mode_updated", and when you open the record, the "Metadata" box shows the previous mode in "de" and the new one in "para". This is where you find out why suddenly nobody can create an account anymore.
Abaixo do quadro de resposta fica \"Conv: Below the reply box is "Discuss the case". Here, the team asks the AI that opened the case questions before deciding, such as "Why didn't the AI resolve it on its own?" or "What has the customer already tried?". This is an internal conversation: the customer sees nothing, and the AI here does not send messages or change the case. Colleagues' questions also appear in this box within a few seconds. Until AI is connected, this box shows a notice instead of the question field; the next step explains why.
Clique no botão do gatilho para ver os d: Click the trigger button to see the details. "Trigger type" selects what starts the workflow. "Minutes of silence" sets how long after the patient's last message counts as going silent (here, 1440). The fields below limit who enters and how often. Fill in "Maximum silence" and "Maximum times per contact", and turn on "Only start if the team has already replied to the customer's last message". Without this, the workflow may reach patients who went silent months ago and repeat endlessly.
A aba \"Leads recebidos\" lista cada env: The "Received leads" tab lists each form submission, newest first: who it is, their contact details, which source they came from, the date and time, the source page, and the result. "Became a lead" means it entered the sales pipeline. "Resubmission" means the sending system sends the same submission again with the same identification code: it does not create another lead. If the same person fills in the form twice, each submission becomes a lead. "Not accepted" means the submission was rejected.
O cartão \"Previsão\" estima quanto deve: The "Forecast" card estimates how much should come in each month from open deals in the main sales pipeline, using each stage's closing probability. No stage in this clinic has a defined probability, so the entire open amount appears under "No stage probability defined — calibration needed". When stages have probabilities, a monthly table appears with the "Weighted" amount (value times probability) and the "Gross" amount (full value). Deals without an expected closing date appear in a separate row.
A \"Cobrança dos seus clientes\" é difer: "Billing your customers" is different: you control it. When enabled, it creates the "Billing" item in the Admin menu, where you build plans and decide which companies start paying. Existing companies remain exempt until you choose. To receive real payments, the Billing screen asks you to connect an Asaas or Stripe account, and the system must use an https address. Paying companies see their own plan under "Plan and billing". Click the switch to see.
O tipo é \"Anonimização cliente\" e o pr: The type is "Customer anonymization", and the deadline of 15 business days has already passed. In "SLA timeline", the bar is full and red, and the right corner shows how many days overdue it is ("d overdue"). A deletion has different stages: "Processing" (D+10) and "Anonymization completed" (D+15), counted in calendar days. The dot turns green when the stage's day arrives, even if nothing has been done: the "Received" badge beside the code tells you whether the request has been fulfilled.
No alto ficam os filtros: período (abre: The filters are at the top: period (defaults to the last 30 days), status, event, platform, and a search by deal name. Choose and click "Filter". Below you see the number of deliveries and the list. Each row's badge shows the result: "Delivered", "Failed", "Waiting" (delivery is queued: the system will retry or is waiting for the platform's confirmation), or "Not sent" (something is missing on your side). "Lead sent" rows are pipeline stage notifications, not sales.
\"Organiza o sistema\" é a parte que tra: "Organizes the system" is the part that works after the conversation. By turning on the switch and selecting what it may do under "What it can change in the system", the agent also opens tickets, assigns them to the right person, and organizes labels and stages. When off, it continues serving customers and the basics are still recorded automatically. Under "Which deals it can manage", select the pipelines it handles: with none selected, it talks normally but does not change any deals.
\"Audit\" é o registro de auditoria: um: "Audit" is the audit log: a notebook where the system automatically records every important thing that happens on the server, across all companies. A transferred conversation, an invitation sent, a published agent, a suspended company: each becomes a row here. Nobody can edit or delete a row through the system. Only automatic cleanup removes very old entries, after 5 years by default. Below the title you can see how many events the list is showing.
Quando um negócio fica parado, sem conve: When a deal sits idle, with no conversation or changes, for longer than normal for its stage (one day unless adjusted), its card gets an orange stripe on the left and a "No reply for…" notice just below the value. The footer stops showing time in the stage. This is the same notice as on the Radar screen. If a follow-up is already scheduled with the customer, the card does not get the notice. Here, Sérgio's assessment has been idle for four days: it is time to contact this customer.
A caixinha à esquerda de cada linha marc: The checkbox to the left of each row selects the conversation without opening it. As soon as one is selected, the bulk action bar appears above the list, with the number of selected conversations. Here we selected Roberto's and Mariana's conversations. Pedro's conversation, open in the middle of the screen, also has a light green background, but is not part of the batch: its checkbox is empty. Only checked boxes count, so the bar says "2 conversations selected".
\"Metadata\" guarda os detalhes da mudan: "Metadata" holds the details of the change as the system recorded them. In this transfer, "to_user_id" is the code of the person who received the conversation and "note" is the reason entered by whoever transferred it. Just below, "Resource Type" and "Resource ID" identify what was changed; here, a conversation. "negocio_aberto" tells you what happened to the contact's deal: "sem_negocio_aberto" means they had no open deal, so nothing changed in the sales pipeline.
Há dois jeitos de mandar e-mail. O prime: There are two ways to send email. The first is your own email server, in the upper box. The second is an "External sending service", in the lower box: a company that delivers email for you. Either one is enough. If both are configured, your own server takes priority, even if its details are wrong: the system does not automatically fall back to the external service. That is why you should always test after saving your own server.
O cartão \"Perdas\" lista os negócios pe: The "Losses" card lists deals lost in the last 30 days in three ways. "By reason" uses the reason selected when the deal was marked lost. "By category" combines reasons into groups: "Price" counts as "Us", "No reply from customer" as "Absence", and "Canceled by customer" as "Customer". "By exit stage" shows which pipeline stage the deal was in when it was lost. The highest count always comes first.
A aba \"Fila\" lista cada paciente que e: The "Queue" tab lists each patient who is or has been in a workflow, along with follow-ups arranged by the AI. Each row shows the patient, the workflow (and the agent handling it), their current step (or the follow-up reason), when the next message will be sent, and the status. The step appears as a short code, such as "resposta-2"; the full name appears when you open the patient's history. Patients with the earliest next message appear first.
No alto da página do agente fica a \"Ope: "Agent operation" is at the top of the agent's page. In automatic mode, it replies on its own, following the rules you configured. In assisted mode, it only prepares suggestions within the conversation, and nothing is sent without a person's approval. The "Pause automatic replies" button immediately stops replies it sends on its own: the settings are saved, assisted-mode suggestions continue, and the button changes to "Resume automatic replies".
'Abrir' leva ao painel da empresa, em Te: 'Open' takes you to the company's dashboard under Tenants. On the 'Billing' card, you can change its plan, grant an extension of up to 60 days ('Grant extension'), or exempt it from billing ('Make exempt'). To exempt a company that still has a subscription with the provider, cancel that subscription there first. For a company with overdue payments, 'Generate payment link' creates a new link for you to send it. If it was suspended for nonpayment, granting an extension reactivates it immediately.
Com \"Aceitar #on/#off enviados pelo cel: With "Accept #on/#off sent from a phone" enabled, any message a team member sends from WhatsApp on their phone pauses AI in that conversation until someone sends #on or clicks "return to automatic". #off pauses it without replying to the customer. When disabled, as in the photo, #on and #off are ordinary text, and replying from a phone pauses AI only temporarily. Note: the command is typed in the customer's chat and may be visible to them.
\"Lembrar\" serve para quando você está: "Remind me" is for when you are waiting for a customer to reply. Choose a deadline: if they do not reply by then, the conversation moves to the top of the list and a notice appears in the Hub saying the customer did not reply in time. Nothing is sent to the customer. The bot was already paused in this conversation. The red bubble is a message that did not go through, and the beige box is an internal team note: neither has anything to do with the reminder.
A aba \"Redes sociais\" traz as mensagen: The "Social media" tab brings messages from your social media accounts into customer support. It uses an external provider you must subscribe to. First paste that provider's "API key" and click "Find profiles". Choose the company's profile and click "Save connection". Then authorize each network under "Authorize account" and, on the account's card, click "Receive in customer support" so messages arrive in the Inbox.
No alto da ficha ficam o nome, o telefon: The customer's name, phone number, and labels are at the top of the profile. Just below are shortcuts: "Schedule appointment" opens the Calendar with this customer already selected, "Contact tags" opens the label editor, "New Lead" opens a new deal for them in the sales pipeline, and "View contact" takes you to the customer's full profile. The red-bordered message in the conversation is simply a failed delivery in this example; it is unrelated to the profile.
Alguns recursos não têm botão \"Ajustar\: Some features have no "Adjust" button: they can only be enabled in the server's configuration file, and the row tells you what to do. Show this text to whoever manages your server. After the adjustment and a system restart, the badge changes to "Configured". "SIP telephony" shows "Cannot check from here": it is set up outside this system, and the screen cannot tell whether it is ready. This does not mean it is disabled.
\"Mensagens / dia\" soma as mensagens en: "Messages / day" adds up messages sent and received by all companies each day, including those from personal contacts, which the table below excludes. "AI cost / day (R$)" shows how much AI cost each day. Note: despite "R$" in the title, the amounts are in dollars (US$), the currency the AI provider bills in. When a chart has nothing for the period, it shows "No data for this period".
\"Ícone do aplicativo e do navegador\" é: "App and browser icon" is the small image shown in the browser tab and installed app. Use a square PNG or JPG image, 512×512 or larger, up to 512 KB. The system does not resize the image for you here. Like the logo, it takes effect as soon as you choose the file. After uploading, a "Remove icon" button appears, restoring the icon the system draws from your branding.
\"Remover da instalação\" tira a extensã: "Remove from installation" removes the extension from every company: those using it stop seeing the guides, and each company's settings remain saved. There is no undo: to bring it back, you must reinstall it from the catalog, which only works if the catalog address is online and still lists that version. Then each company enables it again. Here we only opened the confirmation; to leave without removing it, click "Cancel".
A chave do serviço que envia os e-mails: The email sending service's key and sender address are not on this screen. The link "Email delivery — your own server or an external service — is under Email →" takes you to Admin's "Email" screen, which contains everything about how emails are sent. The yellow "No SMTP configured" banner at the top is a general Admin notice: email delivery is not configured yet. The "Email" menu item takes you to the settings.
Cada linha é uma pessoa: nome e e-mail,: Each row is a person: name and email, role, interface (what they see in the menu), status, and last login to the system. "Accepted" means the person accepted the invitation and has access (Carlos has not logged in yet, so his last activity is empty); "Revoked" means they lost access. Your own row says "you": nobody can change their own role or remove their own access.
Cada linha é uma pessoa, da chave mais n: Each row is a person, from the newest access grant to the oldest. "User" shows their email and name. "Granted at" says how long ago access was granted, and "Granted by" shows the email of whoever granted it. "Scope" says what the person can do, "MFA" says whether they must use two-step verification, and "Status" says whether access is still valid. "Reason" is the explanation entered when access was granted.
\"Marcar como lida\" zera o contador de: "Mark as read" clears the unread count for all selected conversations. At the end, "2 conversations updated." appears and the selection is cleared. "Close" on the bar, beside "2 conversations selected", closes all selected conversations at once and, unlike the "e" key, asks for no confirmation. Do not confuse it with "Close" at the top of the open conversation: that only closes Pedro's conversation.
No quadro 'Cliente nas conversas', em 'O: In the 'Customer in conversations' box, under 'What identifies the customer', choose 'Customer phone' or 'Customer email'. Under 'Column name', enter the field name where the other system stores this information. This way, when a patient writes on WhatsApp, the assistant reads only that patient's rows. If you choose phone, the notice just below explains the required format for the stored number.
\"Passar para uma pessoa\" tem duas chav: "Hand over to a person" has two switches. The first lets the agent call someone on the team when it realizes the case is outside its scope. The second, which only works with the first on, hands over the conversation when the customer mentions a legal matter, such as Procon or a lawyer. "Words that call a person immediately" contains expressions, such as "representative", that send the conversation straight to the team.
\"Aguardando resposta\": a mensagem já s: "Waiting for reply": the message has been sent and the workflow is waiting for the patient. "Paused (human support)": someone on the team took over the conversation. "Paused by a person": someone deliberately put the workflow on hold. "Canceled": the workflow ended early, for example when the patient replies. Pedro's row shows "Promise" and "Scheduled": it is a follow-up the AI arranged with him in the conversation.
A FisioMove Reabilitação está no topo: é: FisioMove Reabilitação is at the top: it is the company that spent the most on AI in the last 30 days. The "Agent" column shows the name of its published AI representative, "Téo — Agenda da Fisio". When a company has more than one published agent, the highest-priority one appears. Note: a paused agent still appears here, so a name in this column does not guarantee it is replying.
Em \"A inteligência que ele usa\" você e: Under "The intelligence it uses", you choose the AI company, model, and "Access key", the code for your account with that company. No key has been registered in this example installation. That is why the red warning and "Register anthropic credential" link appear; the link leads to the screen where you paste the key. Without a key, the agent cannot save changes.
Para instalar, clique em \"Instalar\" no: To install, click "Install" on the module's card. While the server prepares the module's space, the button changes to "Installing…" for a few seconds (in the photo it is still idle). There is no version to choose or company to select: one click installs it for the entire server. Install only what some company on this server will use. This screen has no uninstall button.
O quadro \"Quando\" tem uma barra por di: The "When" box has one bar per day, with the date below. Today is included too: "Last 7 days" shows 8 bars. The taller the bar, the more happened that day. Hover over the bar to see the exact number. On a phone, the number is written below the date. The first and last bars cover only part of a day, so they may be lower.
A empresa tem 7 dias úteis para entregar: The company has 7 business days to deliver a copy of the data and 15 business days to anonymize it. "Due in" counts the time remaining until the end of the deadline's last day, or how many hours overdue it is ("overdue"). "Risk" summarizes this in a badge: "OK" (within the deadline), "Warning" (more than half the time has passed), "Critical" (due in less than 24 hours), and "Overdue" (the deadline has passed).
A linha \"Honorários do contador · Saída: The row "Accountant fees · Expense · R$ 450,00 · day 31" is added to the list. Notice the fields remain filled in: do not click "Add" again, or the same recurring bill will be added twice. To change the amount or day, use "Edit", then "Save". The "×" at the end of the row takes the recurring bill out of use without asking for confirmation; bills it has already created remain.
\"Payload\" guarda os detalhes do proble: "Payload" holds the details of the problem as recorded: here, which number went down and how many minutes ago. "Audit Trail" is this incident's history. It is still empty because this is the first time anyone has opened this page. Each visit is recorded as "platform_admin.incident_viewed", and resolution as "incident.resolved": you will see both rows shortly.
No quadro \"O que você quer fazer?\" voc: In "What do you want to do?", you choose what happens to the case. "Done": you resolved it, and the AI notifies the customer and closes the matter. "I need information from the customer": the AI asks the customer for what is missing, and the case returns to you when they reply. "I can't — hand over to a person": the AI leaves the conversation and a team member takes over customer support.
No quadro \"Inbox\", marque \"Bloquear a: In the "Inbox" box, check "Lock the message box until a staff member takes over the conversation" and click "Apply support rules". From then on, only the person responsible for the conversation can type. Anyone opening an unassigned conversation, or one assigned to a colleague, cannot type or send until they click "Take over". Whoever has already taken over continues replying normally.
A tela de Webhooks liga o CRM a outros l: The Webhooks screen connects the CRM to other places. The "Receive data" tab contains sources: each form or landing page that brings contacts into your sales pipeline. "Received leads" shows everything received through those forms. Under "Automations", you create rules that act on their own, such as notifying another system when a patient closes a deal. "Activity" shows what each automation did.
No Admin, o item \"Destinos internos\" d: In Admin, the "Internal destinations" menu item opens this screen. For protection, the system does not communicate with addresses on the server's own internal network, such as 10.0.0.5 or 192.168.1.20: it refuses before any data or key leaves here. Here you allow exceptions, one address at a time. They apply to the entire server, so only installation administrators see this screen.
Depois do clique, um aviso aparece por a: After the click, a notice appears for a few seconds in the bottom corner of the screen: "Restored the value from the installation file." Since the file in this demonstration has no support email, the "Now:" line disappears and the badge returns to "Not configured". The "Restore default" button also disappears until you save again. Here we also reset the data protection officer's value.
Cada fluxo é um cartão. No alto ficam o: Each workflow is a card. Its name and status are at the top. "Version: published" means the workflow has been published at least once. "Handoff" says what the workflow does when a team member takes over the patient's conversation: "Pause" (waits for the person), "Cancel" (ends the workflow), or "Allow" (keeps sending). The last modification date appears below.
The last boxes follow the same idea. The database address and password show "Required for the system to start": without them, the system cannot even open this screen. The queue password has a matching value in another program. "AI conversation distribution mode" is read by another program only when it starts. All are changed in the server's installation file.
"Card terminal account" has disappeared from the list. If a payment method still pointed to it, that method shows "account removed" instead of its name. Change that method's account soon: the system does not change it automatically, and until you do, money paid through it keeps going to the disabled account. The same applies to recurring monthly bills linked to it.
O selo no canto do cartão diz a situação: The badge in the card's corner shows the workflow's status. "Active": published and ready to receive patients. "Draft": not yet published and sends no messages to anyone. "Disabled": published, but someone turned it off. It accepts no new patients, but those already inside continue to the end. To stop someone, cancel that person's workflow in the Queue.
De volta à aba \"Instaladas\", quem admi: Back on the "Installed" tab, installation administrators see an "Across all organizations" box on the card, counting how many companies have the extension enabled. "Undo last change (back to 1.0.0)" restores the previous version across all companies without downloading anything, so it works even when the catalog is offline. It also asks for confirmation.
Em \"Logo\", clique no botão de escolher: Under "Logo", click the file selection button (on your computer it may say "Select file" or "Choose File") and select the image. It uploads immediately without needing "Save", and "Logo updated." appears. Use a PNG or JPG up to 512 KB, preferably with a transparent background. A "Remove" button then appears to remove the logo.
Antes, clique em \"Descartar alterações\: First, click "Discard changes" to return to the recommended mode. The explorer is further down. On the left, "Tables" shows the allowed tables. Click one and the data appears on the right in a read-only grid, page by page. Here the list shows "Could not read the catalog." because the example database did not respond.
Embaixo de cada item, uma frase curta di: Below each item, a short sentence says why it cannot be changed here, followed by "why?". Click it to read the full explanation. For "Key that locks credentials", for example: it is the key to the vault holding the other passwords, so it lives in the server file, outside the database. Click "hide" again to close it.
A coluna \"Status\" diz em que pé o pedi: The "Status" column tells you where the request stands. "Received": it arrived and work has not started yet (a data copy request waits for someone at the company to approve it). "Processing": work is underway. "Review": it got stuck and needs someone at the company to resolve it manually. "Completed": it finished. "Failed": there was an error and the system gave up after several attempts.
Abra \"Platform Admins\" no menu do Admi: Open "Platform Admins" in the Admin menu. The "Scope" column shows the extent of access. "full" means full access: the person can view and change everything in Admin, such as creating or suspending companies. "support_readonly" is read-only: the person can open the dashboard and see everything, but any attempt to change something is refused. Here, Carlos monitors the dashboard without being able to change anything.
A configuração tem três partes. \"Conver: The settings have three parts. "Talks to the customer" is how it provides support. "Organizes the system" is what it records internally after the conversation. "Checks before sending" shows the checks on each message.
